name: eye-in-the-sky-ground-app-linux
description: Eye in the Sky — Ground Control Center (Electron shell, Linux)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names UI,ELECTRON --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm
